constraints.text: Do not add spoken or sung lines.

claims.text: Bring the attached photo to life with slow drifting motion.
Soft rain motion, glimmering wet reflections, and a quiet ambient score give the still reference sheet a subtle sense of life without adding new lettering or speech.

soundscape: Soft steady rain ambience over a wet rooftop at night, with a faint distant city hum.
music: A restrained ambient score with slow drifting synth tones and low sustained strings.

description.text: The complete vertical character reference sheet remains fully visible exactly as supplied, with its large rainy rooftop hero panel at the top, the three full-body studio turnaround views in the middle, and the four detail close-ups along the bottom. Every existing label stays legible and in place: "HERO", "FRONT", "SIDE PROFILE", "BACK", "FACE", "JACKET COLLAR", "HANDS", and "BOOTS". In the HERO panel, a lean adult with short dark hair shaved at the sides and a small topknot, a diagonal scar above one eyebrow, and a composed neutral expression stands in a slight three-quarter turn on a rain-soaked urban rooftop at night. The figure wears a high-collared black tactical jacket with shoulder straps and metal buckles, a black T-shirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots. Metal railings frame the wet, reflective paving, while distant lit windows and warm amber practical lights glimmer through the cool blue-gray darkness. Rain streaks fall steadily through the panel, beading on the jacket and pooling along the seams of the boots. In the middle row, the same figure is isolated against a near-black studio backdrop in FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and BACK views, each held in a clean neutral stance under soft, directional low-key light that traces the jacket collar, straps, trousers, and boot silhouettes. The FACE close-up shows the direct gaze and the scar above the brow; the JACKET COLLAR close-up isolates dark fabric, a strap, and a metal buckle; the HANDS close-up shows two weathered hands with visible veins and knuckles; and the BOOTS close-up shows dark leather lace-up combat boots with heavy soles and taut laces. A slow, gentle drift animates the whole sheet without breaking its layout or cropping any panel, giving the rain, wet reflections, and fabric subtle life while the studio rows remain steady and readable. The overall palette stays desaturated and gritty, mixing black and charcoal with cool blue-gray night tones, muted amber highlights, and pale skin tones.
Rain streaks glide down through the HERO panel as amber highlights shimmer across the wet rooftop paving, metal railings, and distant windows.
Soft steady rain falls over the wet rooftop at night, with a faint distant city hum underneath.
The figure's jacket fabric and small topknot stir faintly, while reflections on the wet paving ripple and brighten in slow pulses.
The intact sheet continues its gentle drift, keeping the rainy hero panel, the three studio turnaround views, the four detail close-ups, and all existing labels steady and readable.
